run_generate_math_questions: run the script to generate math questions and answers to text files in an output directory
run_split_training_data: run the script with --train_split=True to split generated math questions by difficulty level
run_unsplit_training_data: run the script with --train_split=False to write all generated math questions to a single train directory
run_generate_per_module: run the script to generate math problems per module with alternating question and answer lines
run_generate_with_output_dir: run the script specifying an output directory to write generated math question-answer pairs
